walk.suffix: , mouth closed, no facial animation, no chewing, no talking, eyes still, performing a full walk cycle in place: legs and feet cycling through one complete stride, body bobbing naturally up and down with each step, classic looping sprite walk animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

idle.suffix: , mouth closed, no facial animation, no chewing, no talking, eyes still, gentle idle motion: soft breathing, slight sway, a small bob in place, no walking, no camera movement, no panning

run.action: running at a brisk gallop in place
run.suffix: , legs cycling quickly through a full running stride, body low and driving forward, energetic looping run animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: running fast, mid-stride, legs extended in a gallop, body leaning forward

sleep.suffix: , lying still with slow steady breathing, eyes closed, motionless resting loop, no camera movement, no panning
